Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We have reviewed your renewal offer and the cost context provided. Our counterproposal focuses on a longer agreement, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility; please confirm which adjustments you can approve within your authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 425.71 per unit, 60 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 424.29 per unit, 45 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 422.87 per unit, 30 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Option A amounts to about EUR 5,849,255 over the term.
3. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month agreement and value the long-term commitment.

Our current Angebot is a price of €431.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

In response to the extended contract duration, we can adjust our offer to a price of €430.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months under our standard 30 days net payment terms.

We are unable to accommodate further price reductions at this time and trust this revised proposal provides a solid foundation for our continued cooperation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised proposal and the adjustment in your target prices. 

As our corporate policy currently freezes price reductions, we are unable to lower the unit price below our established limits. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €431.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

However, to accommodate your request for improved payment terms, we can offer 45 days net at €430.88 per unit for the 36-month volume, with a volume of 4580 pcs per year.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

We acknowledge your revised offer and your corporate policy freezing price reductions. We will retain your quoted unit price; please submit our proposal for a longer payment term to your committee or management for approval.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 431.61 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 432.05 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 432.48 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
